'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**[[Israeli settler violence]]
***Five masked [[Israeli settlers]] break into a [[Palestinians|Palestinian]] house in the southern [[West Bank]], killing three sheep, injuring four others, and fire [[tear gas]] into the living quarters. Three children under the age of four are taken to hospital after the tear gas attack. [https://www.latimes.com/world-nation/story/2025-12-23/israeli-settlers-forcibly-enter-palestinian-home-kill-sheep-in-latest-west-bank-attack (''Los Angeles Times'')]
*[[Russo-Ukrainian war]]
**The [[Ukraine|Ukrainian]] [[General Staff of the Ukrainian Armed Forces|Armed Forces]] confirm their withdrawal from [[Siversk]], [[Donetsk Oblast]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/ukrainian-troops-withdraw-eastern-town-siversk-2025-12-23/ (Reuters)]
*[[War on drugs]], [[Operation Southern Spear]]
**[[2025 United States military strikes on alleged drug traffickers]]
***The [[United States]] [[United States Southern Command|Southern Command]] announces [[United States Armed Forces|U.S. forces]] have struck an alleged [[Illegal drug trade|drug trafficking]] vessel in the eastern [[Pacific Ocean]], killing one person. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/new-eastern-pacific-strike-alleged-drug-boat-kills/story?id=128642786 (ABC News)]
*[[Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]]
**The [[Pakistani Taliban]] detonates a [[Improvised explosive device|bomb]] and shoots at a [[Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Police|police]] van in [[Karak District|Karak]], [[Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]], [[Pakistan]], killing five officers. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/five-pakistani-police-personnel-killed-gun-bomb-attack-2025-12-23/ (Reuters)]
*[[Yemeni civil war (2014–present)|Yemeni civil war]]
**In an agreement mediated by the [[United Nations]] [[Office of the Special Envoy of the Secretary-General for Yemen|special envoy office]] and the [[International Committee of the Red Cross]], the [[Yemen]]i [[Presidential Leadership Council]] and the [[Houthis]] release a joint 2,900 detainees held throughout the civil war. [https://apnews.com/article/yemen-prisoners-release-war-houthis-7523c53ce1aff283866d10e9f38e5246 (AP)]

'''Business and economy'''
*The [[Italian Competition Authority]] fines [[Republic of Ireland|Irish]] [[low-cost carrier]] [[Ryanair]] €255 million (US$300 million) for allegedly [[European Union competition law|abusing]] its [[Market domination|dominant market position]] from April 2023 to April 2025 by restricting how [[travel agencies]] sell its flights. [https://www.reuters.com/sustainability/boards-policy-regulation/italy-regulator-fines-ryanair-255-million-euros-alleged-abuse-dominant-position-2025-12-23/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Harmony Jets Flight 185]]
**A [[Dassault Falcon 50]] jet carrying [[Mohammed Ali Ahmed al-Haddad]], the [[Libyan Army]] chief, four other passengers and three crew crashes approximately two kilometers south of [[Kesikkavak, Haymana|Kesikkavak]], [[Haymana]], [[Ankara]], [[Turkey]]. No survivors are reported. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/12/23/signal-lost-with-jet-carrying-libyan-army-chief-over-ankara-turkiye-says (Al Jazeera)] [https://apnews.com/article/turkey-libya-private-jet-contact-lost-0ff39d90fea5798a276efd3122ff8d78 (AP)]

[https://6abc.com/post/explosion-reported-nursing-home-bucks-county-reports-people-trapped/18309877/ (WPVI-TV)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/us/explosion-rips-through-pennsylvania-nursing-home-2025-12-23/ (Reuters)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Montenegro–Turkey relations]], [[Visa policy of Montenegro]]
**[[Montenegro]] reinstates [[travel visa|visa-free entry]] for [[Turkish nationality law|Turkish citizens]] but shortens the permitted stay from 90 days to 30 days after resuming cooperation with [[Turkey]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/citing-better-cooperation-montenegro-lifts-visas-turkish-citizens-2025-12-23/ (Reuters)]
*[[United States–European Union relations]], [[Visa and deportation controversies in the second Trump administration]]
**The [[United States]] imposes [[Visa policy of the United States|visa bans]] on [[Center for Countering Digital Hate]] [[CEO]] [[Imran Ahmed (strategist)|Imran Ahmed]], former [[European Commissioner for Internal Market]] [[Thierry Breton]], [[Global Disinformation Index]] co-founder [[Clare Melford]], and [[HateAid]] CEOs [[:de:Anna-Lena von Hodenberg|Anna-Lena von Hodenberg]] and Josephine Ballon for allegedly pressuring U.S. [[social media]] platforms to [[Freedom of speech in the United States|restrict speech]]. [https://www.reuters.com/legal/government/us-targets-former-eu-commissioner-activists-with-visa-bans-over-alleged-2025-12-23/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Corruption in Romania]]
**[[Romania]]n [[President of Romania|president]] [[Nicușor Dan]] announces an investigation into alleged systemic abuses within [[Judiciary of Romania|the judiciary]] after judges and prosecutors report intimidation and [[undue influence]] by the [[High Court of Cassation and Justice]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/romanian-president-says-judiciary-will-be-investigated-address-claims-abuses-2025-12-22/ (Reuters)]
*[[Epstein Files Transparency Act]]
**The [[United States Department of Justice|U.S. Department of Justice]] releases 30,000 more pages of [[Epstein files|files]] related to [[Jeffrey Epstein]], including allegations of [[Relationship of Donald Trump and Jeffrey Epstein|his ties]] to [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]]. [https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/justice-department/justice-department-releases-3rd-batch-jeffrey-epstein-files-mention-tr-rcna250533 (NBC News)]
*[[Piracy in Venezuela]]
**The [[Venezuela]]n [[National Assembly of Venezuela|National Assembly]] approves a [[Law of Venezuela|law]] that creates prison terms of up to 20 years for promoting or financing activities defined as [[piracy]], [[blockade]]s, or related international crimes. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/venezuela-passes-law-against-piracy-blockades-amid-us-oil-ship-seizures-2025-12-23/ (Reuters)]
*[[Zagreb school stabbing]]
**A [[Croatia]]n man is sentenced to 50 years in prison for fatally stabbing a 7-year-old student at a school in [[Zagreb]] in December 2024. [https://apnews.com/article/croatia-school-knife-attack-sentencing-1aea594e0ead5f360d716326f8b1e275 (AP)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2026 Portuguese presidential election]]
**A [[Judiciary of Portugal|court]] in [[Lisbon]], [[Portugal]], orders [[Chega]] [[President of Portugal|presidential]] candidate [[André Ventura]] to remove campaign posters [[Negative campaigning|targeting]] the [[Romani people in Portugal|Romani people]] within 24 hours, ruling that the materials are [[Racism in Portugal|discriminatory]] and may [[Incitement to ethnic or racial hatred|incite hatred]], or face daily fines of €2,500 (US$2,940) per poster. [https://www.reuters.com/world/portugals-far-right-leader-ordered-remove-posters-targeting-roma-community-2025-12-22/ (Reuters)]
